title: TDS deposit - deductions up to March 2026 (1961 Act)
summary: Tax deducted at source under the 1961 Act is paid to the government by the 7th of the following month, and by 30 April for tax deducted in March. Inside the site window this covers only tax deducted in March 2026, due 30 April 2026.
applicability: Every non-government deductor for sums paid or credited on or before 31 March 2026, even if the deposit is made after 1 April 2026 (old challan and AY 2026-27). Government offices paying by challan deposit March tax by 7 April; book-entry credits are due the same day.
law: Section 200(1), Income-tax Act, 1961; rule 30, Income-tax Rules, 1962 (continued for periods before 1 April 2026 by section 536(2), Income-tax Act, 2025)
penalty: Interest under section 201(1A): 1% per month or part from the date tax was deductible to the date it is deducted, and 1.5% per month or part from deduction to payment. The deductor is an assessee in default (section 201(1)); penalty under section 271C; prosecution under section 276B; 30% of the expense is disallowed for resident payees (section 40(a)(ia)).

other: Assessee in default (section 201(1))
Penalty up to the tax not deducted (section 271C)
Prosecution for failure to pay (section 276B)
30% expense disallowance for resident payees (section 40(a)(ia))
exposure.basis: Section 201(1A): 1.5% per month or part from deduction to payment; 1% per month or part where not deducted

penalty: Interest at 1% per month or part under section 206C(7) from the date tax was collectible to the date of payment; the collector is an assessee in default (section 206C(6A)); penalty equal to the tax not collected (section 271CA); prosecution for failure to pay (section 276BB).

Prosecution for failure to pay (section 276BB)

title: TDS/TCS deposit (Income-tax Act 2025)
summary: Tax deducted or collected at source under the 2025 Act is paid to the government by the 7th of the following month; tax deducted or collected in March is due by 30 April. The same dates now apply to TDS and TCS.
applicability: Every person deducting tax under sections 392/393 or collecting tax under section 394, other than government offices, for amounts paid, credited, debited or received on or after 1 April 2026. Government offices: same day where no challan is used, otherwise by the 7th of the next month including March. Payers using Form 141 (rent, property, individual payers of contract/professional fees, VDA) follow the 30-day rule instead.
law: Section 397(3)(a), Income-tax Act, 2025; rule 218(1) and (2), Income-tax Rules, 2026
penalty: Interest under section 398(3)(a): 1% per month or part from the date tax was deductible or collectible to the date of deduction or collection, and 1.5% per month or part from deduction or collection to payment. The person is an assessee in default (section 398(1)); penalty for failure to deduct or collect (sections 448 and 449); prosecution for failure to pay (section 476); 30% of the expense is disallowed for resident payees (section 35(b)).

other: Assessee in default (section 398(1))
Penalty up to the tax not deducted or collected (sections 448, 449)
Prosecution for failure to pay (section 476)
30% expense disallowance for resident payees (section 35(b))
exposure.basis: Section 398(3)(a)(ii): 1.5% per month or part from deduction or collection to payment; 1% per month where not deducted or collected
